content: Adults aged 65 years and older should receive either the PCV15 (15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine) or the PCV20 (20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine). For adults aged 19 to 64 years who are at increased risk for pneumococcal disease, it is recommended to administer either the PCV15 or the PCV20 if their vaccination history is unknown.
